name: Call of Earth

angles.text: As a shaman, this rite marks a turning point in your training. Communion with earth brings strength, stamina, and deep spiritual insight.
As a tauren, reverence for the Earth Mother lies at the heart of your culture. This trial honors beliefs held by your ancestors.
As a member of the Horde, your shamanic traditions draw on the elements. Your path begins with the grounded resilience of earth.

faq.answer: Call of Earth tests an aspiring shaman's patience and readiness to commune with earth. The seeker must heed its enduring wisdom.
faq.q: What is the Call of Earth?

faq.answer: Earth is the foundation of all things, embodying strength, stamina, and patience. It is the most stubborn and wise element, teaching that all things erode and are reborn over time.
faq.q: What does the earth element represent in shamanic tradition?

faq.answer: A sapta is an elemental draught prepared by a shaman mentor. Accepting it opens a spiritual path and attunes the seeker's senses to elemental spirits.
The Earth Mother is the source of life and balance, especially revered by tauren shamans. She protects those who honor her laws and grants wisdom to seekers who respect the land.
faq.q: Who is the Earth Mother mentioned in the trial?

aliases: what happens when you complete it
faq.answer: Answering the call prepares the seeker for the next step of their path. It brings spiritual rebirth, after which a shaman cannot return to ignorance and new secrets of earth come into view.
faq.q: What happens upon answering the call?

faq.answer: Earth moves through cycles of erosion and rebirth. Mountains wear into deserts and rivers carve canyons, so a shaman needs patience and stamina to attune to these enduring rhythms.
faq.q: Why is patience required to commune with the earth?

sections.body: A shaman learns to commune with the primal force of earth through a formative rite. Earth is the most stubborn and wise of the elements, the steady bedrock beneath existence. It moves through slow cycles of erosion and rebirth. Mountains wear into deserts, and rivers carve canyons over ages. To hear the earth's voice, an initiate needs that same patience.
sections.title: The Foundation of All Things

sections.body: Answering the call changes a seeker beyond return to former ignorance. When the initiate proves readiness and respect for the laws of the Earth Mother, they receive an earthen sapta. The elixir opens a new way of seeing, and the shaman begins to grasp earth's secrets of strength, stamina, and elemental protection.
sections.title: The Sapta and Rebirth

summary: The earth calls a shaman to begin a patient trial of communion. By accepting an earthen sapta, the seeker steps onto a path of spiritual rebirth and learns to hear the foundation of life.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Earth
